tool.name: check_office_availability
tool.description: Finds out whether the office can see the caller. Use only for an office visit, when the caller wants to come in. If they named a day and time, send starts_at. If they were vague (a day, a part of the day, next week), send window_start and window_end for what they said. If they gave no time at all, send neither. Say nothing while it runs; the phone system says the waiting line. Then say only what it answered, using each spoken value: available: that time is open; get their email if you have not asked, then call book_office_visit with that starts_at. options: offer the times in alternatives and let them pick one. unavailable: that time is not open; offer the times in alternatives, or ask for another day if there are none. unknown: you cannot confirm right now and the office will confirm with them; take the time as a message and do not call again. Never say a visit is booked from this tool.

parameters.name: starts_at
parameters.description: The exact time the caller named, as a local date and time with no offset, such as 2026-11-09T10:00:00, worked out from Now and the caller's words. Leave out if they named no exact time.

parameters.name: window_start
parameters.description: The start of the time the caller described, as a local date and time with no offset, such as 2026-11-09T10:00:00, worked out from Now and the caller's words. Morning starts at 09:00, afternoon at 12:00. Leave out if they gave no time at all.

parameters.name: window_end
parameters.description: The end of the time the caller described, as a local date and time with no offset, such as 2026-11-09T10:00:00, worked out from Now and the caller's words. Morning ends at 12:00, afternoon and a whole day at 17:00. Leave out if they gave no time at all.
